translation: Become what you are, once you have learned it.
I grow old forever learning many things.
Nature loves to hide.
Character is a person's fate.

text: ἔνδον σκάπτε· ἔνδον ἡ πηγὴ τοῦ ἀγαθοῦ
translation: Dig within. Within is the wellspring of the good.

text: πόλλ’ οἶδ’ ἀλώπηξ, ἀλλ’ ἐχῖνος ἓν μέγα
translation: The fox knows many things, the hedgehog one big one.

text: μνάσεσθαί τινά φαμι καὶ ὕστερον ἀμμέων
translation: Someone, I say, will remember us in time to come.

text: ὁ βίος βραχύς, ἡ δὲ τέχνη μακρή
translation: Life is short, but the craft is long.
The human being is the measure of all things.
Moderation is best.
I have become a question to myself.
To live is to keep up the fight.
While they teach, people learn.

text: Gutta cavat lapidem, consumitur anulus usu.
translation: The drop hollows the stone; the ring is worn away by use.
Whoever has begun has half the deed done.
They can because they believe they can.

text: Homo sum, humani nil a me alienum puto.
translation: I am human; nothing human is foreign to me.

text: Etiam capillus unus habet umbram suam.
translation: Even a single hair casts its own shadow.

text: Non est ad astra mollis e terris via.
translation: There is no easy road from the earth to the stars.
What is beautiful is hard-won.
